description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific hardware upgrade procedures, including image verification, partition management, and device writing logic for a Linux-based system.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image's partition table matches the existing device; warns if different and prompts user.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Mounts the target partition and copies a backup configuration file to it.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the entire upgrade process including device preparation, partition comparison, image writing, and UUID updating.
